{{Top|leg}}
'''"Average Brown Wookiee"''' was a popular [[Music/Legends|tune]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Listen2|AverageBrownWookiee.flac|"Average Brown Wookiee"|A short sample clip}}
"Average Brown Wookiee" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
